verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is documented first-party as automating sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all transactions (stripe-docs-20). The docs also cover calculating and collecting tax on payment pages without code (stripe-docs-48), and the API covers tax calculations and registrations (stripe-supp-mcp-tools). The evidence is short marketing-level doc snippets rather than in-depth coverage. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of jurisdiction coverage and calculation accuracy, evidence of tax applied across Checkout/Billing/Invoicing flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
